copy.question: Can we interrupt the convergence protocol without turning another consciousness into equipment?
copy.notice_instruction: Read the relay noise at Threshold Interface; the first attributed signal is guaranteed.
copy.follow_lead_instruction: Carry the attributed signal through the inner loop to the Convergence Engine.
copy.contribute_instruction: Recover the missing witnesses and controls, then expose, reroute, or dismantle the convergence protocol.
copy.complete_instruction: The liberation covenant is public. Four relay apertures now wait for accountable commissions.
copy.target_label: the convergence protocol at Convergence Engine
copy.consequence: A successful intervention will preserve independent voices, record who changed the engine, and make the relay apertures commissionable.
copy.completion_memory: You attributed the signal, recovered independent witnesses, and left a public covenant for changing the convergence protocol.
copy.next_invitation: Commission one of the four relay apertures and carry the covenant into the amorphous relay web.
copy.public_trace: recorded an attributed liberation covenant so the next independent actor can audit the changed convergence protocol
